changelog:
- Initial release of ai-viral-team-video-generation (v1.0.0).
- Automates AI video generation, prompt optimization, model selection, video stitching (with FFmpeg), and quality checks.
- Integrates with script writing (ai-viral-team-script-writing) and quality checking (ai-viral-team-quality-check) modules.
- Enforces strict prompt rules: prompts must be complete, only additive modifications allowed, all generations include negative prompts.
- Supports multiple models and adapts output for platforms like 抖音, 小红书, and B站 with various aspect ratios.
